description: Great Lakes Observing System | An IOOS Regional Data Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alliance for Coastal Technologies (ACT); Southeastern Universities Research Association. The Great Lakes Observing System (GLOS) offers data on maritime safety, ecosystems and fisheries, public health, and climate adaptation and seeks to facilitate the gathering, administration, and dispensing of Great Lakes regional data. This data is visible through either the catalog or map view, both of which are good visualization methods depending on users' preferences. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
